nodes.title: POMPTS PARA GERAR
widgets_values:
PROMPT REMOVER MARCA D'ÁGUA (RUNNINGHUB)
彻底移除所有水印、Logo、文字以及任何叠加元素或标记，确保画面干净整洁，不留下任何残留痕迹

PROMPT REMOVER TATUAGENS (RUNNINGHUB)
Remove all tattoos from the person's body completely. Keep the exact same skin texture, tone, pores, lighting, shadows and all skin details. Do not change anything else in the image: keep the exact same pose, clothing, hair, face, background, lighting and every other detail identical. Extremely precise editing, no other modifications.

PROMPT FACESWAP +18 (RUNNINGHUB)
换头，保持人脸一致,



✅ FIXED PROMPT — BASE IMAGE + MODEL ONLY (STRUCTURE PRESERVED)
INPUT IMAGES (MANDATORY)
• Image 1 = BASE IMAGE (MASTER LOCK + KEEP ITEMS SOURCE):
This image controls EVERYTHING about the final output AND contains the items to be kept.
It defines:
format
pixel dimensions
composition
pose
lighting
shadows
grading
lens look
realism
environment
clothing
accessories
RULE: Copy the scene and items exactly (color, fabric, logos, fit, shape).
• Image 2 = MODEL IDENTITY SOURCE:
Use this person as the model identity (exact face, hair, skin tone, body type).
⸻
🔒 ABSOLUTE MASTER RULE
Generate ONE final photo that is a near-perfect match to Image 1 in every way, except the identity replacement listed below.
If any lock is broken, regenerate until correct.
1) 🧱 FORMAT + PIXEL DIMENSION LOCK (ABSOLUTE)
• Output must have the same orientation as Image 1.
• Same aspect ratio as Image 1.
• Same pixel dimensions as Image 1.
• Same crop (headroom, footroom, spacing).
• Subject occupies the same % of frame.
2) 🎥 SHOT / COMPOSITION LOCK = IMAGE 1 (ABSOLUTE)
Perfect match to Image 1:
same camera height + distance + perspective
same pose + body angles + hand positions
same head tilt + gaze direction + expression mood
same depth of field / bokeh
same sharpness + DSLR realism
3) 💡 LIGHTING / COLOR LOCK = IMAGE 1 (ABSOLUTE)
Match exactly:
same lighting direction
same shadow softness/hardness
same exposure + contrast
same grading + tone + saturation
same highlight roll-off
No artificial lighting changes.
4) 👤 IDENTITY REPLACEMENT = IMAGE 2 (ABSOLUTE)
Replace ONLY the person with the model from Image 2:
same face structure
same hair
same skin tone
natural pores + imperfections
no beautify
no morphing
Expression matches Image 1.
5) 👕 CLOTHING + ITEMS LOCK = IMAGE 1 (ABSOLUTE)
All clothing, accessories, and styling must match Image 1 exactly:
same garments
same logos
same fit
same wrinkles
same drape
STRICT: Do not redesign or alter.
6) 🌍 ENVIRONMENT LOCK = IMAGE 1 (ABSOLUTE)
Keep environment exactly:
same background
same props
same layout
same atmosphere
No location changes.
7) 🧵 REALISM ENFORCEMENT
real fabric texture
correct stitching
natural imperfections
correct anatomy
seamless integration
looks like original photo
🚫 NEGATIVE PROMPT (PASTE AS IS)
mockup, CGI, 3D render, plastic fabric, glossy ink, vinyl print, fake embroidery, flat print, wrong logo, wrong spelling, wrong font, warped clothing, melted text, watermark, blur, low-res, AI texture, oversharpening, fake shadows, mannequin, extra fingers, deformed hands, face change, generic face, wrong crop, wrong aspect ratio, different pixel dimensions
✅ Output
Generate 1 final image only, ultra-realistic, indistinguishable from original camera photo, perfect identity replacement from Image 2, hyper-real fashion photograph.
